research_scope: Source-free context-complete mathematical equivalence review of common prerequisites; original candidate identities and the source wording are retained.

aliases.reason: Both source statements quantify over square-zero ideals in commutative unital rings; I²=0 is exactly their shared prerequisite. The unramified/étale uniqueness or existence of lifts remains a separate property.

The monomorphism source requires a,b:W→X with the same source and target; equalizer and coequalizer sources use f,g:X→Y. Both require exactly a parallel pair of arrows in one category, with no invertibility or equality assumption.

Limit and colimit source formulations use identical indexing category I and ambient target category C of unspecified size; the reversal between cones and cocones is a separate source construction, not a difference in the underlying categories.

The diagram F:I→C in the limit and colimit sources is the same covariant functor between an index category and an ambient category, with no assumed smallness of both categories. Cone versus cocone direction is not encoded in this prerequisite.

The two module-theoretic Mittag-Leffler definitions invoke exactly the same natural comparison M⊗_R(∏Q_i)→∏(M⊗_R Q_i), induced by projections; i and j are bound index renamings. Injectivity for all families is the parent definition's condition, not a separate map.
